_doc: Render massing for the Damiaankerk (former Sint-Jozefkerk of the Karmelieten, Aalbeeksesteenweg 7; OSM way 568089136, Q104684557), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB 1739208 rendered as one flat 16.6 m box with a coral flat roof. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of the footprint), u along 'axis_deg' 168 (u points west-north-west, so u +25 is the street front), v towards south-south-west. DHMV II: nave ridge 16 m on v ~ -2, eaves ~8-11 m, lower aisles and porches ~5 m. Look (Commons refs/, Street View and orthophoto look-up): dark brown brick, steep red pantile roofs, a big west gable with a round rose window, a short round turret with a conical roof at the south-west corner.

parts.id: round turret with conical roof, south-west corner
